content.comment_body: Hello all, My employer has purchased several [article_no] and I've been assigned to activate DHCP in the network settings. I cannot locate the DHCP option in the configuration, and setting the IP to 0.0.0.0 triggers an IP address error. Can anyone advise what I may be missing or how to access the DHCP setting? Thank you!
It's not possible to enable DHCP mode directly through the [product_name].
Does that mean DHCP can be set using another method?

You can configure the IP address, subnet mask, and, if needed, the gateway address for the [product_name] in two ways: 1) If the device includes a display, you can set these through its menu. 2) Alternatively, you can use the [product_name] configuration software.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are trying to activate DHCP on a [product_name] with [article_no], but the product only allows static IP configuration either through the device menu or dedicated configuration software. This causes confusion for users who expect to set up dynamic IP assignment easily.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to enable DHCP mode for automatic IP assignment through either network settings or the device menu.
